title: Strings
goal: Character arrays, null terminator aur string library ko safely use karna.
definition: C me built-in string type nahi hai. String char array hai jo null character '\0' par khatam hoti hai.
explain: '\0' ke bina array sirf characters ka array hai, string nahi. strlen, printf %s sab null terminator par rukte hain — missing terminator out-of-bounds read karta hai.
String literal read-only memory me hota hai; char *s = "hi"; s[0]='H' UB hai. Modifiable chahiye to char s[] = "hi";.
Safe functions: strncpy, strncat, snprintf. strcpy/strcat destination capacity nahi jaante — overflow ka khatra.
strcmp 0 par equal deta hai (if (!strcmp(a,b))), lexicographic comparison. strtok original string ko modify karta hai (delimiters ko '\0' banata hai).
analogy: String motar gaadiyon ki train hai jisme last coach par red flag (\0) laga hai — functions wahin rukte hain. Flag hataya to train kabhi nahi rukti.
why: Har text processing, input validation, parsing aur interview question strings par hai. Buffer overflow security bugs ka bada hissa yahin se aata hai.

syntax.note: strncpy null terminate nahi karta agar size kam ho — manually set karo.

topics.title: Null terminator
topics.body: "hello" 6 bytes leta hai. sizeof s = 6, strlen(s) = 5. Array size hamesha length+1 rakho.

topics.title: Library functions
topics.body: strlen, strcpy/strncpy, strcat/strncat, strcmp/strncmp, strchr, strstr, strtok, memset, memcpy. Har function ki capacity requirement aur return value pata honi chahiye.

topics.title: Input aur safety
topics.body: fgets se input lo, newline trim karo. %s me width do. snprintf se formatted build karo. Concatenate se pehle available space check karo.

topics.title: ctype.h
topics.body: isalpha, isdigit, isspace, isupper, tolower, toupper — unsigned char ya EOF par call karo. Manual ASCII comparisons bhi chalte hain par portable nahi.

examples.title: Length, copy, compare
lines: strlen null terminator se pehle ke characters ginta hai.
snprintf size leta hai — overflow nahi.
strcmp 0 deta hai jab strings equal hon.

examples.title: Word count
lines: Loop null terminator par rukta hai (s[i] == 0).
in flag word boundary track karta hai.
Space par in reset, non-space par naya word count.

visual.title: "cat\0" in memory
rows: strcpy(dst, src) 4 bytes copy karta hai

mistakes.why: Null terminator ke liye ek extra byte chahiye.
String literal read-only hai; modify karna UB.

debug.brief: Program ke end me garbage characters aa rahe hain. Fix karo.
hints: strncpy 4 bytes copy karta hai par null nahi daalta.

best: strncpy ke baad null terminate karo

practice.title: Reverse words
practice.prompt: String ke words ka order reverse karo.

mcqs.q: strcmp equal par kya deta hai?

interview.a: Original string modify karta hai, static state rakhta hai (thread-safe nahi), aur consecutive delimiters handle karta hai. Reentrant version strtok_r hai.
Agar source length n se badi ho to null terminator copy nahi hota; agar chhoti ho to baaki buffer null se bhar deta hai (performance). Manually terminate karo ya snprintf lo.
